description: This is a shell script used to set up environment variables, handle authentication directories and files, prepare Docker image testing, and run tests inside a Docker container for the openclaw project. It includes functions for collecting auth info, configuring mounts, and executing test commands with specific environment variables.

methods.name: live_test_cmd
methods.description: Contains the shell commands to set up the environment, copy auth files, prepare working directories, and run tests inside the Docker container.
